hypothesis: A cheap five-field signature is not a function to gold. A menu-relative coarsest-representing map is a function and is Theorem 4 plus a total order. Uniqueness without that tie-break fails. Possibility 1 as a new master object dies.

controls.description: κ_cheap, κ_screen, and κ_unique are written in core.py before evaluate_benchmark inspects gold.
Two cases with the same cheap signature and different gold kill κ_cheap as a function.
κ_screen is named as representability on a finite menu plus coarsest-by-fibres.
Fewest fibres, then lexicographic screen id.
Swap of positions 0 and 3 must send first_bit repairs to last_bit repairs.
calculus_is_sic, calculus_holds, and no_function are valid passing runs.

gates.criterion: The three maps are specified in the module before the run.
The 0↔3 relabel of first_bit/last_bit is natural.
The verdict is calculus_is_sic, calculus_holds, or no_function.
The run does not claim a new master object, an LLM eval, or text nomination.
